subject: swampTroll
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: swamp troll with tusks, mohawk and bone fetishes.
Style: Blizzard/Warcraft.
reasoning:
I'm reviewing the renders against the identity cues—tusks, mohawk, and bone fetishes—checking that each reads clearly. The tusks look a bit small and asymmetric, the mohawk could use more thickness when viewed from the front, and I'm starting to note other issues to flag for revision.

The head reads too small relative to the body, with the neck missing and the ears disproportionately large; since many positions are head-relative, a direct scale fix is tricky, so I'll focus on enlarging the tusks instead. The arms and hands look fine, the staff and its glowing skull eyes read well in the front view, and the back and top views seem solid, though I'm noticing the cauldron may be overlapping awkwardly with the troll's hand in the front view and want to check the positioning there.

I'll thicken the mohawk, enlarge the tusks and widen their spread, and slightly increase eye size so they're more visible in close-up — the ears, war paint decal, hunched posture, and foot details all look fine as is.

The scattered base elements (mushrooms, cattails, stones) and chest loincloth skull look fine, and overall composition with the staff reads well at proper height. I'll keep further edits minimal, focusing on the tusk geometry replacement while being careful to match the original code exactly.

Still writing tusk geometry...

Also need to resize the eyes slightly, bumping glow radius and slit height, and nudging the forward position to match.

Good, that resolves the eye-slit overlap. Now I'm thickening the mohawk by increasing its thickness values and scaling up the growth factor k so it reads bolder against the head.

Scaling the cranium isn't worth the risk since it would throw off eye placement, so I'll leave head size alone and skip the extra facial details too. Instead I'll focus on making the chest skull necklace bigger for visibility—bumping its scale from 0.75 to 1.0—then compile everything into a final list with the view changes.
